method: Every file below was opened and looked at; width and height are the file's own pixel size (read with `file`). Subjects describe what the photo shows; the first clause is the description, later clauses after ';' are working notes. Photos the reference shows on a page carry the route and the element that shows them. Diagrams, swatch cards, drawings, logos, icons, video posters and photos outside the four pool classes are left out and listed in notes.md.
